summary.caption: A high-end commercial studio product shot of a luxury glass perfume bottle standing on a polished dark marble countertop. Photographed on an 85mm portrait telephoto lens at f/1.8 aperture with critical focus locked at 2.2m on the brass sprayer nozzle. Creamy circular background bokeh with delicate warm caustic reflections and clean studio contact shadows.
